content.text:
This Statement of Work covers a full bathroom refurbishment to the upstairs bathroom, to be completed by 10th August. The existing suite and fittings will be fully stripped out, and a new bath with shower over, basin and pedestal, and toilet will be installed, along with a heated towel rail in place of the existing radiator. Approximately 14m² of wall tiling will be fitted, and all making good is included; decorating is not part of this contract. The work will be carried out by a two-person crew over five days, with the bathroom suite and wall tiles supplied by you and all other labour and materials provided by the contractor.

Please note that the condition of the soil stack will not be known until the strip-out is underway — if remedial work is required here, this will be treated as an additional cost to be agreed at the time. It should also be confirmed before work begins that the customer-supplied suite and tiles will be on site and ready for installation at the start date.
